scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: Agent repeatedly deflected responsibility for resolving the customer's multi-room TV failure, claiming that S-Net does not support Powerline devices despite the customer purchasing the official kit directly from S-Net with installation, and advising Emily to contact the manufacturer or hire an electrician before finally assisting with pairing.

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to probe effectively at the start of the call. Will did not inquire about the status of the adapter LED link indicators, cable connections, or error frequency before prematurely attributing the issue to household wiring degradation.

grader.scenario: TV multi-room mini box sync failure over Powerline Ethernet adapters
grader.notes: Multi-room TV diagnostic call by Will resolving a CS1011 handshake disconnection on a TV 360 mini box. After guiding physical re-pairing of the Powerline adapters, full live broadcast and shared cloud recordings are restored. However, Will fails Took Ownership of the Problem by repeatedly deflecting blame onto the customer's household wiring and telling her to hire an electrician, and fails Probing by not checking basic hardware indicators before diagnosing.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: No hold required; continuous step-by-step pairing guidance provided.
